description: Look up an order for a caller and report only the status the order system returns. The agent must not guess shipping dates or promise a refund.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up an order by order id, or by the phone number on the order.

order_id.description: Order id, if the caller has it.

phone.description: Phone number on the order, if there is no order id.

constraints: Require an order id or a phone number before calling lookup_order.
If the tool returns more than one order, ask which order id the caller means.
Report the status, carrier, and date exactly as the tool returned them.
Do not offer a refund, replacement, or address change. This task is status only.
success_criteria: The spoken status matches the lookup_order result for the confirmed order.
The agent asks for an identifier when both order id and phone are missing.
